also.text: Russia says it downed nearly 700 Ukrainian drones overnight.
Latvia says the Ukraine war may reach a tipping point next year.
Poland says a peace deal would not end Russia's sabotage in Europe.
Amnesty says Ethiopian strikes in Tigray should be probed as possible war crimes.
UN urges an independent probe into the Benghazi port attacks.
Iraq's PM orders the oil ministry to run Kurdish-area oilfields.
US discusses plan to train Syrian soldiers in demining.
Senate panel probes Vance's role in the Vitol Venezuela oil deal.
Arm extends CEO Rene Haas's tenure to 2033 amid Nvidia speculation.
Blast in Hanoi kills 6, injures more than a dozen.
Landmine casualties hit a five-year high of 7,000.
Germans reject a choice between the US and China.
Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh on 16 December.
Japan to pay full 2027 ICC contribution early.
GTA VI hacker walks free on time served.
Australia to treat AI as a key foreign policy issue.

lead.summary: Shares fall about 5% in early New York trading after Monday's 31.5% surge. Trump claims he “made the deal” to bring Huang back; Congress presses ahead with its China chip probe.
